observation.visible_scene: A dim, heavily misted forest interior. Several vertical tree trunks, the most prominent one left-of-center being densely wrapped in climbing ivy/vines, stand amid thick dark-green undergrowth and leafy branches. The background fades into pale grey fog, and the overall color cast is a low-saturation teal/green consistent with overcast or dusk light. The framing is a fixed medium shot of the woodland; no person, animal, or artificial object is present.
visible_changes: Across the sampled frames the composition remains essentially unchanged: the ivy-covered trunk, the right-side trunks, and the background fog hold the same positions, indicating no detectable pan, tilt, or zoom (camera appears locked).
No object translation, deformation, or occlusion change is resolvable between the first and last frame; the scene reads as a static or near-static interval.
Any variation between frames is limited to very subtle, ambiguous shifts in fog brightness/contrast that cannot be confirmed as physical motion.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether wind or a breeze is actually present (leaf motion, if any, is below the resolution of these samples).
What occurs before t=0 and after t=3.33 in the source video; the segment is an arbitrary crop and may continue unchanged beyond it.
The cause of the dim lighting and mist (time of day, weather) is not shown.
uncertain_details: Whether the faint brightness differences between frames are real atmospheric drift, exposure flicker, or compression noise.
Whether there is any micro-camera movement too small to track from these stills.
